title: SoftBody3D: free vertices lag behind pinned vertices
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible with GodotPhysics3D in 4.4.1.stable, 4.5.dev4, 4.5.dev5, 4.5.beta1, 4.5.beta2
Reproducible with Jolt Physics in 4.5.dev5, 4.5.beta1, 4.5.beta2. Not reproducible in 4.5.dev4 and earlier: before 5e27318, the whole SoftBody mesh lagged behind attachments instead of stretching.

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev5 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7652) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13500HX (20 threads)

### Issue description

When the SoftBody3D is attached to a moving Node3D, only the edges that are adjacent to pinned points stretch and they never contract until the attachment stops completely. The mesh drifts from its pinned points and overlaps itself, which causes some faces to become flipped. Without back-face culling, this introduces a visual glitch. The stretch intensity is dependent on the physics tick rate.

GodotPhysics3D:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f98eb2a-df4e-4e3d-b77a-3ede1db2d363)

Jolt Physics (after 5e27318):
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b3494cbb-97fb-4286-938f-ab1e1d21869f)

### Steps to reproduce

On MRP start, the SoftBody3D is accelerated to 20 m/s, when the visual glitch first appears. Edges adjacent to pinned point increasingly stretch as attachment target accelerates, and the stretch remains constant after it stops accelerating.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[softbody-normals.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20556906/softbody-normals.zip)
